purpose: Resolve the fulfillment-delay and economic-cost choices without treating collaborator input as a scientific execution blocker.

thesis_evidence.lead_time_source: Garrido thesis section 6.8.2, printed page 111 (PDF page 112): finished products at Op9 allow troops to be supplied within a pre-set lead-time of 48 hours.
thesis_evidence.autotomy_semantics: Garrido thesis section 5.5.1 and Algorithm 1: APj is defined when a risk intersects the order interval and CTj = LTj.

published_cost_baseline.source: Garrido et al. 2024 section 3.1 assumption (6), journal printed page 7 (PDF page 8).
published_cost_baseline.interpretation: Published isolation assumption, not MFSC monetary calibration.

fulfillment_delay_decision.historical_lane_reason: It was selected before the present audits as the smallest tested delay beyond LT=48 that reproduced the raw-workbook ReT order of magnitude.
historical_lane_must_not_be_reinterprete: the value that maximizes dynamic or neural headroom

prospective_robustness_grid.selection_rule: All rows are reported. No row may be selected because it creates more headroom or a more favorable controller ranking.
prospective_robustness_grid.claim_rule: A delay-universal claim requires directionally consistent results across the declared grid. Otherwise report a delay-by-policy interaction and keep claims conditional.

required_semantic_columns: thesis_exact_autotomy: CTj = LTj within a declared numeric tolerance

monetary_calibration_required_for: a deployment recommendation based on a scalar economic optimum
promoting Cobb-Douglas to a policy-selection endpoint

primary_resource_comparison.service_thresholds: Report as an explicit sweep; no exploratory threshold is called deployable.

economic_decision.replication_baseline: All seven coefficients equal 1, as published by Garrido et al. 2024.

relative_price_grid.reporting_rule: Report winner/rank stability and the physical Pareto front. Do not label any multiplier a price estimate.

economic_decision.strategic_injection_rule: Strategic procurement/injection remains a separate physical resource unless a sourced conversion into Garrido's seven-term kappa is prospectively frozen.

joint_frontier_boundary.enumerated_domain: 6^3 buffer vectors x 3 shifts = 648 static postures
joint_frontier_boundary.interpretation: Shift preferences that vary with buffer vectors establish an interaction and rule out a context-free shift ranking. They do not by themselves prove metric invalidity.
joint_frontier_boundary.cobb_douglas_warning: Unanimous S1 rankings are conditional on the uncalibrated c=1 cost baseline and cannot be treated as economic validation.
